rules.statement: A breach of a covenant to pay rent does not automatically entitle the landlord to cancel the lease, but requires the non-payment to be deliberate and persistent for two years, with proper notice given by the landlord.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is well settled law that it is not in every case of failure to pay rent the landlord is entitled to ask for a cancellation of the lease. To claim such a right the non-payment must be deliberate and persistent or contumacious. That is not all. The lessee must be in arrear of rent for 2 years."
